facts.text: The hotel is on the Congo River in the city center of Brazzaville, on Avenue Amilcar Cabral.
facts.excerpt: Kempinski Hotel Brazzaville is located on this avenue, in the city center, overlooking the Congo River.

facts.text: Maya-Maya International Airport is about 15 minutes by car from the hotel.
The Nabemba Tower is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.
Airport transfers can be arranged on request, from executive sedans to SUVs for groups and families.
facts.excerpt: Luxury transportation can be arranged upon request, with options ranging from executive sedans to spacious SUVs for groups and families.

facts.text: Every guest is welcomed by the hotel's Lady in Red, a host dressed in red.
facts.excerpt: every guest has been welcomed by our Lady in Red, a symbol of intuitive, personalised, and thoughtful hospitality. Dressed in striking red

facts.text: Congo River-view rooms and suites have panoramic river views and private balconies.
facts.excerpt: Our Congo River-view rooms and suites offer panoramic views across the river’s vast expanse, allowing guests to witness one of Africa’s great waterways from the privacy of their own balcony.

facts.text: Le 12 Waypoint is a rooftop venue for sundowners with views across the river towards the Kinshasa skyline.
facts.excerpt: Le 12 Waypoint: A rooftop destination ideal for sundowners, with sweeping views stretching across the river towards the Kinshasa skyline.

facts.text: La Capitale and Mosaïc serve menus that combine European culinary techniques with Congolese ingredients.
facts.excerpt: La Capitale & Mosaïc: Experience menus where European culinary techniques meet Congolese ingredients, creating refined fusions that celebrate local heritage.

facts.text: Le Tropical is the outdoor dining venue, with river breezes and summer cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Le Tropical: The premier destination for outdoor dining. Enjoy river breezes, refreshing summer cocktails

facts.text: Le Café de Paris offers a European-style morning with artisanal pastries and coffee.
facts.excerpt: Le Café de Paris: Perfect for guests seeking a classic European-style morning with artisanal pastries and expertly crafted coffee

facts.text: The hotel has an infinite swimming pool and a spa.
facts.excerpt: Relax beside our infinite swimming pool, enjoy a restorative treatment at our luxury spa

facts.text: The spa offers tailor-made treatments inspired by local botanicals.
facts.excerpt: our Luxury Spa offers tailor-made treatments inspired by local botanicals

facts.text: The concierge can arrange private Congo River charters with sundowner refreshments.
facts.excerpt: Private Congo River charters complete with sundowner refreshments and panoramic waterfront views.

facts.text: The dry season runs from June to September, with cooler temperatures and lower humidity.
facts.excerpt: The dry season, from June to September, features cooler temperatures and lower humidity, making it the most pleasant time to visit.

facts.text: The rainy season runs from October to May, with warm temperatures, high humidity and brief heavy showers.
facts.excerpt: The rainy season runs from October to May, bringing warm temperatures, high humidity and brief but heavy showers.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as the city's first premier five-star luxury address.
facts.excerpt: Kempinski Hotel Brazzaville is the city’s first premier five-star luxury address.
